sentenceIntentions.text: Before breakfast, Lea’s mother asks to die, and her reconstructed husband asks for a thousand bodies.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Open with two startling requests in one family morning
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel immediate curiosity and intimate pressure

sentenceIntentions.text: Me and My Robots begins where extraordinary technology collides with an ordinary family morning.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the novel through ordinary domestic collision
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand the genre and emotional scale

sentenceIntentions.text: Lea is a professional witness, asked to weigh choices that cannot easily be undone.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Introduce Lea's professional role with irreversible choices
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Know why she must respond to these requests

sentenceIntentions.text: Her society has automated much of life, but abundance has left love, consent, and responsibility unsettled.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Place abundant technology beside unresolved consent and love
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See the future's success without moral simplification

sentenceIntentions.text: Even Kite, the household robot, has something difficult to explain about a handmade bird.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Introduce Kite's handmade bird without revealing its message
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel curiosity about a household robot's unexpected concern

sentenceIntentions.text: This science-fiction novel finds its tension in familiar gestures made unfamiliar by new kinds of possibility.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect familiar gestures with unfamiliar possibilities

sentenceIntentions.text: Who may choose for another person when care, memory, and powerful systems all have a claim?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Ask who may choose amid competing claims
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the difficulty of benevolent authority

sentenceIntentions.text: Join Lea in the kitchen, where a better world still begins with impossible conversations.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Invite entry into the kitchen before outcomes
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to hear the family conversation unfold
